notes:
Sharper artwork everywhere. Reelm now requests a poster size that matches how big the artwork is actually drawn, instead of always taking the smallest one the metadata provider offers. Posters on the home screen, search, My List, Continue Watching and title pages are noticeably crisper, and the app automatically asks for higher-resolution art on a 4K panel.

The banner on the title page was the worst case — it was loading a 480x270 image into a box over 1100 pixels wide. It now loads the full-size artwork.

Stream cards show the addon's star rating next to the addon name again.
